readmeExcerpt:
TeamAI — Make Every Team AI Native

English | 中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | ไทย

**The shared foundation for how your team works, learns, and improves with AI.** TeamAI turns individual AI capabilities into shared team capabilities — across agents, machines, and team members. ## Why TeamAI

## Quick Start Send this one line to your AI tool: ```text Install the teamai skill: https://github.com/Tencent/teamai-cli/tree/main/skills/teamai , load the teamai skill, then set up TeamAI for my team from scratch. ``` Once TeamAI is set up, just talk to the `/teamai` skill in your AI tool: **Set up a team from scratch** ```text /teamai Help me set up TeamAI for my team from scratch ``` **Join a team** ```text /teamai Help me join my team's TeamAI, repo URL is https://github.com/your-org/your-repo ``` **Share with the team** Skills, rules, MCP servers, and other agent resources can all be shared: ```text /teamai Share my xxx skill with the team ``` **Open the dashboard** ```text /teamai Open the TeamAI dashboard ``` Once a teammate is set up, they just open their agent and already have the team's full set of AI assets.
Command-line install ### Install ```bash npm install -g teamai-cli ``` ### Team admin / solo user Create a shared-experience repo on your git host (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit, or a private Git service), **grant write access to team members**, then run `teamai init https://github.com/your-org/your-repo`. > **No team repo yet?** Start from a template pre-loaded with production-ready skills, rules, and review agents. Browse the [teamai-hub](https://github.com/teamai-hub) org, click **Fork**, then `teamai init` against your new repo. ### Team members ```bash # Choose one, depending on where you want resources installed # Project-scope init (default, resources installed under the project directory) cd /path/to/my-project teamai init https://github.com/your-org/your-repo # Or, user-scope init (resources installed under ~/) teamai init https://github.com/your-org/your-repo --scope user ``` Once initialized, every AI session automatically pulls the latest skills / rules and other Harness updates published by admins — no manual sync needed.
## Product Overview Three layers of capability, built on Git: - **Team Execution** — make every agent work the team's way: skills, rules, docs, env, agents, hooks, MCP, models. - **Team Context** (beta) — make every agent understand the team: learnings, codebase graph, teamwiki. - **Team Improvement** (beta) — make every execution improve the team: usage, sessions, dashboard.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A CLI tool to manage and synchronize team skills, rules, and knowledge across multiple AI coding agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: TeamAI is a command-line interface developed by Tencent to solve the problem of fragmented agent configurations across engineering teams. It provides a centralized way to manage custom skills, codebase rules, Model Context Protocol (MCP) settings, and shared knowledge. The tool automatically synchronizes this context across popular AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex without requiring manual updates. By connecting to a shared Git repository, team admins can distribute production-ready prompt rules and tools globally or on a per-project basis. This ensures that every developer's AI agent operates with the same architectural understanding and coding standards.
keyFeatures: Cross-agent synchronization: Automatically pushes updated skills and rules to various AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
Centralized management: Uses a shared Git repository as the source of truth for all team-wide AI configurations.
Dual scoping: Allows configuration deployment either globally across a user's machine or locally within a specific project.
MCP integration: Manages and distributes Model Context Protocol configurations to standardize tool access.
Pre-loaded templates: Offers quick-start templates containing production-ready skills for new teams.

useCases.title: Standardizing coding rules
useCases.description: Ensure every developer's AI assistant strictly adheres to the team's custom architectural guidelines.

useCases.title: Distributing custom tools
useCases.description: Deploy internal MCP servers and custom CLI skills simultaneously to all engineering workstations.

useCases.title: Onboarding new developers
useCases.description: Instantly configure a new hire's AI coding environment by pulling the team's shared context repository.

useCases.title: Managing cross-platform agents
useCases.description: Keep context synchronized even when team members prefer using different IDEs or terminal-based agents.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: TeamAI is designed for engineering managers, tech leads, and developers working in collaborative environments. It is essential for teams that rely heavily on AI coding assistants and need to enforce consistent coding standards across different tools.
